reuse the Lean 4.35-compatible upstream revision

in sources.json. File headers and named authors are retained.
For primary files lacking a header, identical licensed source at revision

Per-file source URLs, revision/hash evidence, excerpts, adapted hashes, and
exact migration patches are recorded in sources.json and migration-diffs/.
Only the dependency closure of actual proper Cech-cohomology finiteness is
included. Import namespaces, Lean module exports, named canonical monoidal
instances, and compatibility tactics are adapted to this project's pinned
Lean/mathlib. Removed redundant closing tactics do not add assumptions.

The selected endpoint is
AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.orderedBaseCechHomologyFinite_of_isProper.
It uses arbitrary Noetherian commutative base rings, with no characteristic-
zero restriction or supplied cohomology-finiteness premise. See the exact
statement in ForMathlib/SchemeModuleProperLowDegreeCechFinite.lean.
The local final theorem's #print axioms audit records its complete transitive
axiom dependencies. This notice alone is not a verification claim.
